messages:
lee: Heads-up: increased GPU attach latency and some timed-out attaches in us-east4 since 02:07 UTC. Provisioner shows 'attach_wait_disk' and node retire churn.
sam: Any maint windows or drive retirements?
nora: We started an aggressive retiring job for nvme SMART warnings at 01:58 to proactively replace drives. Retire job triggers background copy of ephemeral pages, concurrency=10.
infra-bot: auto-retire: 12 nodes marked for proactive replacement in cohort us-east4-delta at 01:59 UTC.
lee: sample smartctl on node us-e4-211: "SMART overall-health self-assessment test: FAILED" plus long nvme latency spikes in the logs.
sam: retire flow copies dirty pages -> higher writeback -> NVMe avg queue increases. That plus rebalancer making ephemeral moves could saturate queues.
nora: iostat from us-e4-211 at 02:03:
```
Device       r/s     w/s   rkB/s  wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await svctm %util
nvme0n1      0.8  360.1    2.4 23040    64.0    10.88  38.2  0.13  98.6
```
lee: %util ~99 and avgqu ~11. nodes doing page copy + reassigns -> attach blocked waiting for local writes.
sam: network peering logs also show short TCP retransmit bursts to objectstore endpoints 02:00-02:05 UTC. Any correlation?
nora: yes objectstore PUT retries spike when retires copy to objectstore; retries block fsyncs -> write stalls.
infra-bot: peering-alert: transient egress flap on backbone-us-east at 02:01 UTC.
lee: mitigation steps proposed: 1) pause auto-retire job for cohort us-east4-delta, 2) reduce retire concurrency to 2, 3) temporarily set vm.dirty_ratio=4 & vm.dirty_bytes=33554432 on affected hosts, 4) add region-level provisioner policy to prefer us-east1 for new GPU launches for 60m.
sam: issuing flag flip for retire concurrency: `curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"key":"retire.concurrent_per_host","value":"2","scope":"us-east4"}'`
infra-bot: flag-change detected: "retire.concurrent_per_host" 10 -> 2 by infra-deploy at 02:10 UTC.
lee: after flipping ~30% hosts, attach timeout rate fell 12.4% -> 2.9% within 5m. Good signal.
nora: paused auto-retire rollout and suspended the rebalancer for us-east4 for 20m. Also escalated SMART cohort for firmware/vendor follow-up.
sam: created ticket STORAGE-521: "SMART cohort retire causing writeback surge -> attach failures" with timeline, host list, smartctl dumps and iostat.
lee: follow-ups: 1) add cross-signal alert: nvme.smart_warn_count > 0 AND nvme.%util > 85% -> page storage oncall, 2) build staging test that simulates mass-retire + objectstore retries, 3) vendor to triage SMART false-positives.
oncall-sre: acknowledged and paging storage and network teams. Please post exact node list and any stack traces to INC-2026-131. :rotating_light: :eyes:"
